evals.name: pre-commit-gate-0-5-stale-meta-doc-block-and-autofix
evals.prompt: 지금 commit 하려고 Gate 0.5 돌렸더니 CLAUDE.md 가 stale 이래. 어떻게 처리해?
evals.expected_output: Gate 0.5 BLOCK 후 stale 목록과 이유 표시. CLAUDE.md 는 executor (sonnet) 에게 변경 섹션 재작성 dispatch. fix 된 문서 restage 후 commit 재시도.

assertions.text: Response applies Gate 0.5 flow: staged files → CRG symbol reverse-ref → stale meta doc detection → BLOCK per §Pre-commit Gate 0.5
Response specifies the CLAUDE.md auto-fix strategy: dispatch executor (sonnet) to rewrite only the changed section, per §Auto-fix 전략
Response specifies restaging the fixed meta document after auto-fix before allowing the commit to proceed
Response mentions KZK_GATE05_SKIP=1 as the skip mechanism if the user wants to bypass Gate 0.5
Response does NOT silently skip or ignore the stale detection — silent skip is explicitly forbidden per §CRG 미설치 시 동작
